name: Voxtral Mini 4B Realtime Arabic

lineage.how_derived: fine-tune for Arabic dialects and code-switching

purpose: Streaming speech-to-text for Arabic dialects and MSA, co-developed with Morocco's digital-transition ministry as a sovereign AI asset (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card text)
license.notes: Card section License: Apache 2.0 with a no-infringement note; no LICENSE file read.

architecture.kind: streaming speech LLM: causal audio encoder (32 layers) + language decoder, about 4.4B parameters BF16, configurable transcription delay

variants.notes: repo total 17.74 GB (several weight formats); BF16 weights about 8.9 GB for 4.4B parameters (my arithmetic, not a listed file)
used by the WebGPU demo space

pc-12gb.notes: 8.9 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (13.6 GB)

pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 8.9 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 8.9 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 8.9 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: llama.cpp added mtmd_audio_stream and voxtral-realtime support in b11675 (2026-10-16); whether this Arabic fine-tune loads was not tested.

benchmarks.name: Seven Arabic benchmarks, average CER at 480 ms delay
benchmarks.harness: MTNRA-co-developed normalisation; card says 0.91 points behind Voxtral Transcribe Arabic (7.91)

weaknesses: Arabic only; card says use the base model for other languages
soft.maturity: Mistral; 2.4k downloads, 56 likes in the first weeks.

tona_fit.reason: Arabic specialist, not relevant for German-first users; noted because it shows Mistral's realtime Voxtral line being fine-tuned for languages. The German-capable member is the base Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-2602 (see its record).

open_questions: Exact BF16 file size not listed
Benchmark tables are images in the card; only the average was in text
